text:
alex: FYI onboarding ardent14b-int4 to canary (p4d-small). hit a couple of allocation failures during a short ramp. pasting notes and snippets.

priya: can you include the runtime + traffic profile? curious about batch and max_new_tokens.

alex: canary baseline we used:
```yaml
model: ardent14b-int4
traffic_profile: chat-ramp-heavy-history
runtime:
  batch_size: 18
  max_new_tokens: 700
  prefetch_kv: true
  slab_cushion_pct: 5
  slot_compaction: moderate
```

otto: 18x and 700 tokens with prefetch on p4d is asking for fragmentation. those freelist churns usually start with kv allocations.

alex: initial log excerpts: 
``n[2026-06-02T08:22:11Z] ERROR kv_alloc: request=128MB reason=freelist_fragmentation
[2026-06-02T08:22:11Z] WARN slot_compactor: pass start
[2026-06-02T08:22:12Z] ERROR gen_worker: reserve failed for 64MB -> OOM fallback
```

priya: immediate mitigations to test: cut batch_size -> 6, drop max_new_tokens to 256, disable prefetch_kv, bump slab_cushion to 10, set slot_compaction to aggressive. Also reduce kv_max_entries to a conservative cap.

otto: add kv_trim_threshold=0.55 and set kv_eviction_policy=least_recent to avoid long prefixes holding large cached blocks. For generators, try kernel_affinity=soft_isolate to smooth compactor impact.

alex: applying quick patch now. snippet used:```json
{"runtime": {"batch_size": 6, "max_new_tokens": 256, "prefetch_kv": false, "mem": {"slab_cushion_pct": 10, "slot_compaction": "aggressive"}, "kv": {"kv_max_entries": 1500, "kv_trim_threshold": 0.55, "kv_eviction_policy": "least_recent"}, "kernel_affinity": "soft_isolate"}}
```

deploy-bot: canary rollout requested by alex -> pool-p4d-small (3 hosts)

priya: run a synthetic ramp with 5k requests and capture alloc_fail counts + p99 lat. If stabilizes, run a 200-prompt eval comparing int4->fp16 outputs for regressions with reduced max_new_tokens.

alex: synthetic 5k run completed: alloc_fail=0, p99 gen latency increased by ~35ms, throughput -9%. summary: "alloc_fail:0 | p99: 360ms | avg:140ms | throughput:-9%"

otto: sounds stable. run the eval and check for truncation or hallucination due to shorter default. Also sanity-check long-history behaviour with a targeted 50-chat test.

qa-bot: eval suite queued: 200 prompts (semantic + structural checks) and a 50-chat long-history smoke.

priya: early eval delta: embedding-sim median=0.982, 5/200 prompts flagged for minor format differences (trimmed newlines/closing punctuation). no semantic loss detected. 50-chat smoke had 0 OOMs and stable tail latency.

alex: moving to phased rollout -> 30% after another hour if no regressions. notes: prefer opt-in prefetch toggles for canary until model defaults are tuned.

otto: long-term ask: add per-model safe-defaults derived from (model_size, quant_type, gpu_family) + a preflight frag-smoke that ramps conc gradually (0->20->50) and measures freelist churn. Also expose a "frag-susceptibility" score in model-catalog UI.

priya: will open infra ticket to implement model-defaults and frag-smoke automation. also add a checklist item: when lowering max_new_tokens, always run the 200-prompt quality check.

alex: copying error excerpt into onboarding notes and closing initial triage: 
``n[2026-06-02T08:22:11Z] ERROR kv_alloc: request=128MB reason=freelist_fragmentation
[2026-06-02T08:22:12Z] WARN slot_compactor: freed=24MB duration_ms=47
[2026-06-02T08:22:12Z] ERROR gen_worker: allocation failed reserving 64MB for tail tokens
```

priya: great writeup. thanks alex and otto. leaving canary open for 6h and will report any anomalies. :white_check_mark:
